name: @epms/platform
description: Enterprise Project Management Suite - internal project and workflow management platform with conversational AI task execution
author: Hakeem Shah <hakeemshah.tech@outlook.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.start:dist: npm run build:dist && shx cp .env dist/.env && cd dist && npm run prisma:generate && npm run start:prod
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && shx rm -rf node_modules dist out .next
scripts.docker:build:dev: docker build -f Dockerfile.dev --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -t epms:dev .
scripts.docker:build:prod: docker build -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S) -t epms:latest .
scripts.docker:publish:dev: REG=${INTERNAL_REGISTRY:-registry.internal.company.com}/${IMAGE_NAME:-pm-app}; VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version"); SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S); docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$SHA -t $REG:dev -t $REG:$VER-dev -t $REG:$VER-$SHA --push .
scripts.docker:publish:stable: REG=${INTERNAL_REGISTRY:-registry.internal.company.com}/${IMAGE_NAME:-pm-app}; VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version"); SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S); docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.prod --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$SHA -t $REG:latest -t $REG:$VER -t $REG:$VER-$SHA --push .
